Definition: from G2596 and G680; to seize upon:--fasten on.
BiblicalUsage: Paul gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, and a viper came out of the heat and fastened on his hand.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the viper fastened on the wrong man, because the fire that should have killed Paul only proved God was with him.
